status: Independent local semantic audit; no joint approval or adoption.

originalSourceEvidence.excerpt: Game masters choosing to continue beyond epilogue may select one of three arcs.

Arc A Rekindling StarsHook one of the new constellations above Yieldheart flickers out nightly. Investigation reveals stray Null fragment shapes star energy into weaponized silence. Party must recover fragments before dawn of Equinox.

Arc B Conclave of Untitled SongsHook Bards across Aethel forget melodies at random. Source is an errant equation echoing from Broken Ladder strands lost in upper atmosphere. Characters undertake sky vessel voyages to retrieve the strand.

Arc C Devil’s SignatureHook Infernal contract appears on Citadel quartz naming a player character heir to Cania engine patents. Acceptance grants knowledge but binds them to supply contradictions annually. Refusal invites Mephistopheles envoy to test free will.

issues.title: Mooring cannot support the stated empty craft

evidence.value: 30x20x15ft hull, empty3000lb, AC15,120HP. Cabin20x15x12ft;10ft-wide12ft-high hatch. Fixed bolted pilot/engine stations each occupyone5ftsquare. Validate actual full footprints, clearance and gear; no displacement into solid matter.

One fixed8ft braided lightstrand, mass8lb when secured, suspended beside an intact40x40ft lightlattice at the recorded30mile altitude. Vessel may moor to its one actual10ftwide hook; mooring needs one pilotAction and one engineerAction and pauses powered hovering only once secure. Lattice supports2000lb including tether force, NEW and announced; no permanent travel network.

Tell this arithmetic before launch. The viable ordinary default is powered outbound5hours,60minute strandwork, powered horizontal return2hours, then gravity-canopy descent30miles at300ft/6s=52minutes48seconds. Powered time480minutes, elapsed8h52m48s. Air12h lasts;120fuel minutes remain. This is a real route choice, not an unstated extra tank. Other plans require actual extra fuel/landing/support. The stated default deliberately keeps the engine powered through the60minute site phase. Once safely moored, the pilot may instead shut it down and save the actual unpowered minutes; air time continues. Record the chosen plan, not both fuel outcomes.

issues.finding: The platform rating is 2000 lb including tether force; the empty craft is 3000 lb before crew, passengers and cargo. The offered engine-off mooring plan therefore lacks a supporting structure under the printed load rule.
issues.requiredResolution: Local successor proposes a 6000 lb combined deck-and-mooring rating. Count actual hull, supported equipment, bodies and tethered load once. This fixes the simple rating contradiction but still needs the full stock/load envelope and overload/transfer procedure in ARC03-02/03/06.
requiredWorkedCases: Empty and fully loaded craft supported at the mooring; same person moves from craft to deck without double-counting; combined support exactly at rating and above rating.

1600lb total passengers, crew, carried gear and cargo; fixed empty mass excludes these. Maximum6breathing occupants, each no larger thanLarge, subject to actual space. A Large creature needs a10x10ft footprint. Crew masses130+170lb already include their personal listed property. Fuel/air hardware included in empty mass; replacement supply lots are accounted as cargo until installed.

Six finite emergency breathhoods, each2lb included in empty load unless removed. Action to don/activate on willing self or willing/unconscious adjacent creature with compatible head anatomy. Each protects one creature from the printed highAtmosphere hazard for60elapsed minutes once. No reset by swapping or removing; incompatible anatomy needs an actually acquired alternative before departure. It grants no flight or impact protection.

One actual materiallot aboard covers one repair; other stock requires real acquisition. This ordinary active repairwork may receiveTransition under its exact workOrder/qualification rules. It never restoresfuel/air/hoods/pads/canopy. Canopyabove0 may regain10HP fromoneactivehour,10gp material and actual tool; stock10gp aboard forone such repair. Hull/canopy0 requires a separately authored replacement, not reset.

Harnesses are mundanegear and use actualload/anchorcap600lb each. Lattice andhullpositions mustkeep linewithin50ft.

issues.finding: The draft supplies a pound capacity but no vessel Load capacity. Hoods are called part of empty load; clamps, tongs, lined case, harnesses, repair material and some consumables have no complete mass/Load placement. A mass total cannot yet be checked without assumptions. The current body rules require pounds and Load separately, with container contents counted once.
issues.requiredResolution: Provide one inventory ledger with documented mass, Load, quantity, initial location and whether included in hull mass or payload; define the craft Load capacity as NEW. Use the actual body/casualty Load rules, melded-gear mass and footprint rules. Make removal/consumption/installation transfers explicit. Do not turn assumed mass into historical source fact.
requiredWorkedCases: Four actual characters plus two crew, all personal gear and mission kit; full/empty refill containers; Large and no-breath passengers; a petrified or transformed body; a load that passes pounds but fails Load.

issues.title: Support after power loss and missing crew is undefined

evidence.value: Powered speed10miles per actual travel hour; tactical speed90ft per one vehicle movement event/numbered round, horizontal or vertical. One actual pilotAction plus one actual engineerAction completes one coordinated event; no native vehicle turn or extra controller-swap movement. A singleactor cannot fill both roles in the same round. Distinct capable trained operators with Engineering proficiency or the specific operator instruction below can replace crew.

One tank holds600powered minutes. Stock starts with600installed minutes plus one sealed300minute refillcanister20lb at dock, not aboard unless loaded. Every elapsed minute powered, including powered hovering or controlled manoeuvring, spends1minute; fractional use accumulates. Powered motion stops at0. Refilling docked or stably landed takes10minutes with actual canister; consume transferred supply, no overfill and no fuel creation.

One reusable gravity canopy, AC12HP20, is mounted outside. A pilotAction deploys it while the hull is above0HP. Record deployedAt. The first controlled descent step occurs6elapsed seconds later, then every6seconds:300ft down, stopping at actual supporting ground. These are fixed absolute deadlines; initiative changes, extra turns and new pilots do not add or rebase steps. No fuel or engineer contribution is needed. This is explicitly NEW controlled machinery, not ordinary Falling. Without steering, horizontal movement is0. A pilotAction may set up to30ft of legal lateral displacement for the next pending step; later steering Actions replace that setting, never add another movement event. After the step, consume the setting. Validate full hull clearance and support. It lands safely only when the canopy and hull remain intact and the actual supporting footprint is legal. Canopy0HP or unsupported hull0HP ends this support and starts ordinary Falling under the existing marker,300ft steps and full uncontrolled-distance impact. Independent falling creatures gain no canopy effect. Deploying an intact canopy on an intact hull ends its current uncontrolled fall; subsequent loss of support starts a genuinely new fall, not a silent reset of already resolved impact.

One fixed8ft braided lightstrand, mass8lb when secured, suspended beside an intact40x40ft lightlattice at the recorded30mile altitude. Vessel may moor to its one actual10ftwide hook; mooring needs one pilotAction and one engineerAction and pauses powered hovering only once secure. Lattice supports2000lb including tether force, NEW and announced; no permanent travel network.

issues.finding: Fuel at zero stops powered motion, but the draft does not say whether unsupported hover remains possible. It also does not define support when a necessary operator cannot contribute, or how engine, mooring and canopy modes exchange support. The text cannot establish when an actual fall begins.
issues.requiredResolution: Write a finite support/movement state procedure. Distinguish supported dock, active flight/hover, moored support, controlled canopy descent and ordinary Falling. State crew reservations, actual support-loss timestamps, legal restart/unmoor conditions and the existing fall-marker interaction. Do not infer stopped generation or automatic pause from user-interface delay in any example.
requiredWorkedCases: Fuel reaches zero while unmoored; pilot or engineer becomes Incapacitated; canopy deployed before/after a real fall marker; safe restart at mooring; extra controller Actions do not add movement.

issues.title: Opening the hatch has no pressure or air transition

evidence.value: Cabin seal supplies12elapsed hours of breathable comfortable air forup to6eligible occupants from first activation, regardless of temporary occupancy changes. Reopening it at safe ground does not replenish charge. One actual replacement12hour cartridge20lb at dock, installation30minutes while safely landed and unoccupied. No onboard generator. Loss of seal suspends protection without pausing cartridge depletion.

NEW scenario danger applies above10000ft only to unprotected breathing creatures. At each complete unprotected minute CONsaveDC15: failure3d6cold plusone coreExhaustion, successhalfcold and noExhaustion. Cold defense affects only cold; an actual exact environment/breathing exemption retains its scope. Exposure is cumulative across short exits within this flight; one full minute in working protection clears the incomplete-minute counter, not damage/Exhaustion. This is a fantasy local encounter hazard, not real atmospheric simulation. It does not impose a second unnamed suffocation track. Telegraphed before departure. The printed cold damage represents harmful inhalation of this anomalous upper-atmosphere air. An actual no-breath trait therefore exempts this complete local inhalation hazard; it does not confer immunity to separate ordinary or magical external cold. The draft still requires comparison against actual ancestry/class environmental adaptations before joint adoption.

At hull60HP or less cabin seal fails; an engineerAction at the actual station plus one patchpad restores it if hull remainsabove0. A sealed pad is consumed even if later breached. A new crossing fromabove60 to60orless breaks it again; continued damage while already≤60 does not repeatedly undo a repair unless a single hitdeals20or more post-defense hull damage. Stock4patchpads aboard. Hullat0 loses allpowered movement and airseal; no HP or stock restoration by repair ritual without real work.

Six finite emergency breathhoods, each2lb included in empty load unless removed. Action to don/activate on willing self or willing/unconscious adjacent creature with compatible head anatomy. Each protects one creature from the printed highAtmosphere hazard for60elapsed minutes once. No reset by swapping or removing; incompatible anatomy needs an actually acquired alternative before departure. It grants no flight or impact protection.

The fixed on-site sequence has three phases. Phase1 is20elapsed minutes of local lattice alignment, beginning on arrival at the marked mooring point. During that interval the pilot and engineer must complete the mooring Actions, and a character must set dial order3-1-4 withthree Actions. Those Actions use real actors/budgets inside the20minutes; they do not add automatic extra time. If either requirement is still incomplete at the20minute mark, wait until both are completed, then start a fresh20minute alignment interval. These observation minutes are not halved byTransition. A character without the score can spend30active minutes on INT(Investigation)DC15 to derive the order; failure gives no false answer and permits an actual retry. A wrong order causesone3d6psychic pulse to creatureswithin10ft,WIS15half, then resets the dials and invalidates that alignment interval. Phase2, only after successful alignment, uses one actual tooluser and allthree clamps for10active minutes. Phase3 uses actual insulatedtongs and one worker for30active minutes to release the strand and place it in the real linedcase. Phase2/3 are proposed NEW complexsalvagework eligibility forTransition, requiring joint review; no change to the currently adopted module is asserted. Their prerequisites persist throughout actual work. InterruptedPhase2 loses its incomplete phase; interruptedPhase3 retains only completed10minute blocks. With correct supplied order and no interruption, phases20+10+30 total60minutes, including the mooring/dial Actions inPhase1. Actual optional preparation, failed study and interruption add real time.

issues.finding: Workers must reach the exposed lattice, but the draft never states whether opening/closing the ordinary hatch breaks/restores cabin protection, how long that takes, or whether a hull breach still prevents resealing. Work lasts 60 minutes while a hood lasts 60 minutes, so boarding/closure and equality boundaries matter.
issues.requiredResolution: Provide an actual entry/exit and hatch procedure, including opening and closing Actions, real positions, any airlock if deliberately authored, damaged-seal behavior, cumulative exposure counters and exact hood-expiry ordering. Do not assume an unprinted airlock or lengthen hoods silently.
requiredWorkedCases: Outward and return hatch cycles with unprotected crew; hood expiry exactly at resealing; damaged hull after closing hatch; a worker delayed beyond the hood interval.

issues.title: Current annual record has no unique meaning at departure

value: Issuer: Veyr of the Second Margin, licensed courier for the Canian engine patent office. This local license grants only the powers written here. It does not speak for every devil or mortal court.

Offer and title: the named claimant is designated heir to the office’s three specified engine patents, CF-1 Isolation, CF-2 External Cooling Loop and CF-3 Pressure Seal. Acceptance registers this limited present title, gives one personal paper copy of all three plates, and permits their stated demonstration procedures. The title grants no past ancestry, other estate, soul claim, class proficiency, spell, feat or authority over other people. Its rights apply only to these named office records and the printed local bench arrangement.

Term and bond: informed signature or an understood witnessed mark on this exact document, together with deposit of50gp in actual coins, begins the term at timestampT0. Without the actual deposit no term begins. The first contradiction is due atT0+400elapsed24hour days, the next atT0+800days, and so on while the term continues. This contract chooses Aethel civil years. Descent openings, primordial Cycles, travel and session count do not change these deadlines. The50gp bond remains identifiable held property until a printed return or forfeiture.

Delivery: submit one fictional contradiction for each annual record by placing its written statement in the public quartz-panel slot or dictating it to Veyr at an actual public meeting. Identify two mutually incompatible claims, one actual observed record supporting each, and one concrete question that could reconcile them. Acknowledge known uncertainty honestly; fabricated evidence does not qualify. A previously accepted identical pair of claims and evidence cannot pay another year. Materially new conflicting evidence can support a new submission, with the changed record identified. No real-player secret or belief is required.

Review and grace: the slot retains the actual paper in a visible accessible drawer. Within24elapsed hours of an available issuer receiving it, Veyr gives a numbered written receipt identifying the annual record and the three required fields. A timely submission remains provisionally timely during review. Rejection must name the absent or nonconflicting field. The claimant has10days from actual notice to correct it; a valid correction completed exactly at that deadline resolves before termination. Accepted correction satisfies only its identified annual record. Delayed review or grace never rebases later annual due dates. If more than one annual record is outstanding, each needs its own qualifying submission; one physical delivery may contain several statements.

Examples: one actual record says a sealed chamber was empty atnoon; another shows a named witness inside atnoon; the question asks whether either clock was misread. Or one actual published proof says all accepted gate keys are iron and also records an accepted glass key; the question asks which premise fails. Rain on one day and sun on another do not conflict. The examples teach the form; they are not fabricated observed records the claimant can submit unchanged.

Departure: the claimant may end future participation by an understood declaration to Veyr or a signed statement in the panel. If the current annual record has already been accepted and no earlier record remains unsatisfied, return the actual50gp bond and end the term. Otherwise the claimant may first satisfy those records, or choose immediate exit by forfeiting that50gp bond. This is the entire exit cost. The finite patent title and demonstration permission end; the retained paper copy, learned information, soul, memories, hitpoints, class abilities and unrelated property are not erased or taken.

Default: an unsatisfied annual record after its printed due/grace interval ends the term, forfeits the actual50gp bond and ends the limited title and bench permission. This is the complete default consequence. No additional curse, compulsory mission, death, unbounded debt or automatic Paladin Oath breach is created. These consequences must be disclosed before signature.

Refusal: no term begins. Veyr may offer the separate free-will exercise, which may also be declined. Silence, coercion, incapacity, deception about these terms or another person’s signature cannot create informed acceptance. The claimant may negotiate a different complete written offer before signing; no change is assumed accepted.

Amendment: a new clause requires the claimant’s informed agreement to a complete visible revised document before it takes effect. Veyr cannot change a running deadline retrospectively. The old and new documents remain recorded.

Unavailable issuer: destruction of the panel does not destroy already written records or cancel an obligation; the claimant can arrange actual public delivery to Veyr. When the issuer is unavailable through a due date, a timely documented delivery attempt with the real statement retained gives10days after actual renewed availability to deliver that record. Each later annual record is tracked separately if the absence spans another due date. No extra cold cells, bench charges or duplicate patent copies appear during the absence.

issues.finding: Bond return requires the current annual record to be accepted, but no rule identifies that record after the first due date or at an exact boundary. One reading requires an undued second record immediately after year one; another requires only records already due. Early submission and early retirement are also not fully ordered.
issues.requiredResolution: Define record numbering, when a record opens, which records must be satisfied for bond return and how early fulfillment works. Preserve the annual obligation and meaningful source benefit. Publish the exact choice in the player handout; do not resolve it through an unannounced penalty.
requiredWorkedCases: Exit immediately after acceptance with no statement; exit after early accepted year-one fulfillment; exit one day after first due date; exit at the exact next annual boundary.

issues.finding: The separate clauses define due dates, a 24-hour review, 10-day correction and issuer absence, but do not provide a single state table for timely pending submissions, no submission, late first submission, paper theft, delayed review or an absence spanning several annual records.
issues.requiredResolution: Provide a per-record state machine and exact simultaneous-event order. A timely pending submission must not default while its allowed review is pending. bodyCapacityEvidence.excerpt:
For another creature, mount, floor or platform supporting you, count your effective body weight plus all actual equipment in your custody, including melded items, once. For your own inventory capacity, count what you carry, not your own body weight. Conditions change only the items or body their exact rules affect.

## Carrying and Load

Use pounds for actual weight and Load for inventory burden. Extraction Class describes cargo danger and attention. A casualty's Load describes the difficulty of transporting a body; it is not the body's weight. These quantities answer different questions and never convert automatically into each other.

The following is a **new provisional reconciliation** of V6 physical handling with the staged Gameplay Loop inventory rules. It does not promote the historical Gameplay Loop file into the approved books. V6's optional encumbrance variant remains preserved as an alternative; do not add its penalties to this Load procedure.

| Carrier size | Physical carry limit in pounds | Push, drag or lift limit in pounds | Inventory capacity in Load | Casualty Load for a body of this size |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Tiny | Strength score × 7.5 | Strength score × 15 | Strength score ÷ 2 | 1.5 |
| Small | Strength score × 15 | Strength score × 30 | Maximum of 0 and Strength score − 2 | 3 |
| Medium | Strength score × 15 | Strength score × 30 | Strength score | 6 |
| Large | Strength score × 30 | Strength score × 60 | Strength score × 2 | 12 |

Use the character's current Strength score, not the modifier or an imported monster score. Tiny's Inventory capacity and casualty Load are new provisional additions. The pound limits come from V6; Small, Medium and Large Load values come from the Gameplay Loop. Larger unsupported transport sizes require their own completed rule before this table can handle them.

Keep fractional Loads without rounding. An item with a printed Load uses that value. If it has only a known weight, its **provisional Load is pounds divided by ten**. A Load-only item may use ten pounds per Load as a clearly labeled estimate for ordinary hauling; this is insufficient for effects requiring documented physical mass.

Count a container's own empty Load plus the contents' Loads, unless an explicitly inclusive Load already covers those exact contents. Handle pounds separately: sum the empty container weight and contents' weights, or use an explicitly inclusive gross weight for the contents it covers. An inclusive Load does not make a printed weight inclusive, or vice versa. Apply this rule through nested containers and meld budgets so every item counts exactly once in each quantity.

With positive carried Load at or above half capacity and no greater than capacity, you are **Burdened**: reduce Speed by 10 feet and apply disadvantage to checks to climb, swim or move silently. An empty inventory is not Burdened, including at zero capacity. Above capacity, that inventory cannot be carried routinely; drop or transfer something, or use a legal alternative such as dragging or a vehicle. These threshold and zero-Load details are provisional clarifications.

Apply actual physical limits when handling a known weight. Between physical carry capacity and twice that capacity, pushing or dragging uses the lower of otherwise-current Speed and 5 feet. A Speed of 0 stays 0; a Speed of 3 stays 3. Lifting does not independently permit movement: moving while supporting a weight must satisfy carrying, pushing, dragging or another exact rule. An anatomy restriction, such as Hawk's prohibition on carrying a Medium ally, still applies even if numbers would fit. Burden penalties do not create hands, harnesses, lift or access to melded gear.

Transporting a creature must pass both checks: the carrier can physically handle the body's effective weight and associated equipment, and can accommodate the casualty Load plus the equipment's Load. Petrified multiplies the body weight by ten, not its casualty Load. Removing gear can reduce equipment weight and Load; it cannot reduce the body's weight or erase its condition.
